title: Trackpet – Your pet's health, in one place
description: Trackpet keeps your pets' health records on iPhone, iPad and Mac: weights, vaccinations, antiparasitics, therapies, appointments and documents, with reminders and a health report for the vet.
og_description: Your pets' health records, reminders and a report for the vet, on iPhone, iPad and Mac.
hero_lead: Weights, vaccinations, antiparasitics, therapies, appointments and documents, with a reminder when something's due and a health report ready for the vet. For iPhone, iPad and Mac.
hero_status: Coming soon to the App Store.
hero_phone_alt: The Pets list, with each pet's photo, kind of animal and age
features_title: Everything the vet asks about, a tap away.
features_lead: Every record your pets need, for as many pets as you have: dogs, cats, rabbits, birds, fish, turtles and more.
feature_pets_text: Each pet's page shows its latest weight, temperature, diet, therapy, vaccination, antiparasitic, appointment and bath at a glance, with allergies where they can't be missed.
feature_weights_text: A chart of every weighing, with the change, the lowest and the highest, and how far the pet is from its target. Temperatures say whether they're normal for the species.
feature_vaccinations_text: Boosters still to give, the soonest first, and how many days of coverage each antiparasitic has left.
feature_therapies_text: Each medicine with its dose and the times it's given. Mark each dose given, and see how many have been given so far.
feature_reminders_text: At each dose's time, before an appointment, and the day before a booster is due or a coverage ends. Mark a dose given right from the notification.
feature_calendar_text: Every pet's records on a month, a dot for each kind, and what happened or is planned on any day.
feature_documents_text: Lab results, prescriptions, certificates and invoices, from Photos or Files, or scanned with the camera. Searchable, a section for each year.
feature_report_text: A PDF of a pet's details and records, for its vet or whoever looks after it, to share, print or mark up.
feature_clinics_text: Your clinics with their phone, email, address and vets, shared by your pets. Tap to call, write or find one in Maps.
feature_costs_text: What each visit, vaccine, medicine, antiparasitic and bath cost, a year at a time, for one pet or all of them together.
feature_siri_text: “Log Paco's weight in Trackpet”, or ask what's due today or when the next appointment is. In Spotlight and with the Action button too.
feature_ipad_mac_text: Your pets in a sidebar, with the calendar and each pet's page beside them. On the Mac, menus, keyboard shortcuts and what's due today in the menu bar.
feature_data_text: Back up every pet, with its photo and records, to the Files app and restore it, or export spreadsheets in CSV.
feature_yours_text: Five app icons, kilograms or pounds, Celsius or Fahrenheit, and the app in English, Italiano, Français or Español, whatever your device's language.
feature_access_text: VoiceOver throughout, and layouts that hold up at the largest text sizes, in light and dark mode.
screenshots_lead: Designed for iOS 26, with Liquid Glass, haptics and VoiceOver throughout.

privacy_lead: Trackpet doesn't collect any data. What you keep is between you and your devices.
privacy_account_text: Open the app and add your pet. There's nothing to sign up for.
privacy_tracking_text: No ads, no analytics and no third-party code.
privacy_device_text: Your pets, their photos, records and documents are stored on your device, and nowhere else.
contact_title: We'd love to hear from you.
contact_lead: Questions, ideas, or something that doesn't work as it should? Send an email and we'll get back to you.
faq_download_answer: It's almost ready: a beta on TestFlight comes first, then the App Store. This page will link to it as soon as it's out.
faq_devices_question: Which devices does it run on?
faq_devices_answer: iPhone and iPad with iOS 26 or later, and Mac with macOS 26 or later.
faq_pets_answer: As many as you like: dogs, cats, rabbits, birds, fish, turtles and other reptiles, and any other animal as Other. Each has its own records, and the calendar shows them all together.
faq_sync_question: Do my pets sync between iPhone, iPad and Mac?
faq_sync_answer: Not yet: each device keeps its own pets. To move them to another device, back them up and restore them there (Settings › Backup).
faq_reminders_answer: Check that Trackpet may send notifications: Settings › Notifications in the app shows it, and opens the system's settings if needed. Then check that the record has its reminder on: a medicine's times, an appointment's alert, a booster's or an antiparasitic's reminder.
faq_report_question: How do I give my vet my pet's records?
faq_report_answer: On your pet's page, tap Health Report: Trackpet makes a PDF of its details and records and opens it, so you can see it before sharing, printing or saving it. If the pet has a clinic with an email, Send Health Report writes to it with the report attached.
faq_send_question: Does Trackpet send anything to my vet by itself?
faq_send_answer: Never. A report or a document goes to the clinic only in an email you write and send yourself, from your own mail account.
faq_new_iphone_question: How do I move my pets to a new iPhone?
faq_new_iphone_answer: In Settings › Backup, choose Back Up to Files and save the file somewhere you can reach from the new iPhone, like iCloud Drive. Then, on the new iPhone, choose Restore from Backup. The backup has every pet, with its photo, records and documents.
faq_units_question: Can I use pounds or Fahrenheit?
faq_units_answer: Yes: Settings › Weight and Settings › Temperature. Everything is shown in the units you pick, the health report and the spreadsheets too, and you can change them any time.
faq_support_question: Can I contact support from the app?
faq_support_answer: Yes: Settings › Help and Feedback › Send Feedback writes an email with details that help us find a problem, like the app version, your device and iOS version. It never includes your pets' names, notes or photos, and you see everything before you send it.
faq_delete_question: How do I delete my data?
faq_delete_answer: Everything is on your devices. Delete a pet to remove it with all its records and documents, or delete the app to remove all of it. Backups, spreadsheets and reports you saved stay where you saved them until you delete them.

support_lead: Answers to common questions about Trackpet, and how to reach us.
support_contact_text: Questions, ideas, or something that doesn't work as it should? Write to us. From the app, Settings › Help and Feedback › Send Feedback adds the details that help us find a problem.
policy_description: Trackpet doesn't collect any data: your pets' records stay on your devices. How photos, documents, reminders, Siri, backups and emails work.
policy_summary: Trackpet doesn't collect, keep or share any of your data. What you keep about your pets stays on your devices.
policy_collect_text: Nothing. There's no account, no ads, no analytics and no third-party code, and the app doesn't send your data to us or to anyone else. If you've chosen in your device's settings to share analytics with app developers, Apple may send us anonymous crash reports and usage statistics.
policy_device_title: Your pets' records stay on your devices
policy_device_text: Your pets, their records, photos, documents and costs, your vet clinics and your settings are stored only on your device. They don't go through a server.
policy_photos_text: Trackpet uses the camera only when you take a pet's photo or scan a document, with your permission, and sees only the photos and files you pick. A photo is made smaller and its metadata, like where it was taken, is removed before it's saved.
policy_reminders_text: Reminders are scheduled on your device, which shows them at their time. They don't come from a server.
policy_siri_text: When you use Trackpet with Siri, Shortcuts or Spotlight, Apple handles your request, under Apple's privacy policy. Trackpet doesn't receive anything more. Your pets' names are added to your device's Spotlight index, so you can find them there.
policy_files_text: Backups, CSV spreadsheets and health reports are files you create, saved or shared where you choose, like the Files app, iCloud Drive or an email. Trackpet doesn't send them anywhere.
policy_clinic_text: When you send a health report or a document to a clinic, Trackpet writes the email in your mail app, with the file attached, and you send it yourself. Nothing is sent without you.
policy_email_text: If you write to support from the app (Settings › Help and Feedback › Send Feedback), the email includes the app's version, your device model and system version, your language, region and time zone, whether notifications are allowed, and how many pets you have. It never includes your pets' names, notes or photos, and you see the whole email before you send it. We use it only to answer you and to fix problems.
policy_children_text: Trackpet doesn't collect data from anyone, children included.
policy_changes_text: If this policy changes, this page will show the new version, with its date at the top.
